title: Numbers don't reconcile: where must the check live?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Recompute in code, hold on mismatch
rule: If the model can hide a mismatch, make it report the mismatch: stated total, calculated total, conflict flag.

title: Retries failing: is the information there to find?
head: Situation
Right move
Why
rows: Nullable field; route out of the loop
rule: Before improving a retry, ask whether the answer is in the document. If not, stop retrying and represent absence.

title: Want to measure false positives: who supplies the judgement?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Need per-category rates, no human labelling
detected_pattern on findings + dismissals logged by ID
Uses developer clicks as the signal
Need a true precision estimate, reviewer time available
Stratified sample of that category first
One category is mostly false positives
Noise erodes trust in good findings
Want a second opinion on hard cases
rule: To find which rules are noisy, tag each finding with its rule and record each dismissal against it. Then the rate per rule is a query.

title: Retries keep failing: is the value there to find?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Retry fixes it on attempt two (sum mismatch, format)
Value printed in an unusual place on some layouts
Model doesn't know where to look
Nullable field + route to a person
Pressure to fill a required field
rule: Retry with feedback fixes format and structure errors, not missing information. Make such fields nullable and route absence to a person.

title: Tidy but wrong values: measure them or stop them?
head: Goal
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Stop wrong values on each document
Send only doubtful items to people
Per-field confidence, calibrated on labelled data
Learn error rates by field or type
rule: Self-reported confidence and run agreement are not measures of correctness. Catch tidy-but-wrong values with outside records and calibrated per-field confidence.

title: Output fails a check: what kind of error is it?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Model miscalculates a fact you could compute
Output fails a check code can run
Validate; retry with the specific error
Errors are judgement calls no rule catches, budget allows
Don't retry; route to a human
rule: Give the model the facts it keeps miscomputing, then validate its output in code and retry with the exact error.

title: Validation failed: retry, or hand off?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Answer is in the document, retry says only "try again"
Answer is not in the document
Stop retrying; route to a human
Need the model to surface its own conflicts
rule: When retrying, say exactly what failed. Stop retrying only when the answer isn't in the document.

title: A retry keeps failing: feed back the error, or hand off?
head: Situation
Right move
Why
rows: Specific errors available; fix reachable in the source
Model can correct with targeted feedback
Needed information absent from the source
Subtle logic bugs that tools don't report
rule: Retry with the specific errors when the fix is reachable; hand off when the information is absent.

title: Validation failed: retry with feedback, or route?
head: What failed
Information in source?
Right move
rows: Nullable field / route to a person
rule: Specific error + information present → retry with feedback. Information absent → route to a person.
